title: LGCTFM_CONTRACT -- one LGIC legacy-transform run's contract, one file per run
description: Authored FROM infra/logic/11_LGCTFM_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_RECORD.md (the Rule 24 four-postulate record and its token census for this schema; LGIC_LGCTFM PRD DEC-1, cell LT-s-1). Every enum below cites the record section that adopts or mints it; this schema mints no enum value the record does not name. A run's contract is one row per resource that composes ONE SUBJECT (record s.0): RESOURCE and PLANE rows carry a CURRENT half (measured) and a DESIRED half (built by lib/opal_naming.py, never typed); FORK rows carry resources that do one job twice; TENSION rows carry one disagreement between the halves each.

_about.description: free-text provenance note on a fixed-input or planted file; not part of the contract's own fields

ranking_rule.description: PRINTED, not a score (record s.4): order by irreversible, then client_facing, then live, then rules_colliding, object_count as tiebreak (08_TENSION_MAP.md s.0)

plan.description: derived from the contract, not part of it (record s.0); the run's plan packages, when emitted

untypeable.description: R-36: the COUNT of nodes this run met whose node_type the naming schema does not grade. Such a node is NOT written into rows -- the enum's equality with NAMING_SCHEMA.json by subtraction is what lets this contract say a type is ungraded (Rule 24(i)) -- and is NOT discarded: it is carried in the run's own PLANT_UNTYPEABLE.json with verdict NOT_COVERED. The count is REQUIRED so that an empty carrier cannot be read as 'the walk met none': a printed zero is a measurement, an absent one is silence.

allOf.description: LT-e-5 (round 3, R-79): schema_version 1.1 REQUIRES the coverage block. A 1.0 contract -- every run written before round 3, frozen history under R-43 -- is graded exactly as it was: the block is neither required of it nor admitted on it, so no frozen run changes verdict and no 1.1 run can drop its coverage by claiming the old version.

coverage.description: LT-e-5 (round 3): what the run's 'involved' instrument reached, per node_type, against a token FLOOR re-measurable by a different instrument. The one carrier of this shape is org/missions/D14/LGIC/LGIC_LGCTFM/deliverables/2.0.0_SA_COO~G/fixed_inputs/r3/R3_BASE.json coverage_block_shape; the definition of 'involved' is written in `instrument` and in infra/logic/10_LEGACY_TRANSFORM.md s.9. Arithmetic the schema cannot express and the round-3 checker grades: per node_type involved == rows + len(not_covered); `rows` counts contract rows of that type whose node is involved; `excluded` holds FLOOR nodes judged NOT involved; a NAMED class (LAMBDA, EC2_INSTANCE, EVENT_RULE, SCHEDULE, DYNAMODB_TABLE, IAM_ROLE, S3_BUCKET) carries neither an exclusion nor a not_covered entry.

instrument.description: the run's definition of 'involved', in words

vintage.description: the graph's own 'Built from the estate as of ...' line

by_node_type.description: keyed by node_type; deliberately NOT bound to $defs.node_type: an involved node of a type outside that enum is exactly what a not_covered entry must be able to name

cell.description: One fact-slot: {value, status, evidence}, no bare values (ATOM_DECOMP Rule 14's rectangle; ssot_establishment.schema.json $defs.cell, adopted -- record s.3, s.6). evidence's minimum-viable form here is {instrument, blind_spot} at least (record s.3: 'evidence = {instrument, locator, vintage, denominator}, its minimum-viable form'; blind_spot is this contract's own addition, carried on every planted cell).

cell_status.description: record s.3, adopted whole from ssot_establishment.schema.json $defs.cell.status

row_kind.description: record s.1.2 -- RESOURCE (default, one node of one of the 33 types), PLANE (one tier plane prefix), FORK (the one token this record mints -- a relation on resources whose DESIRED form is one string)

node_type.description: record s.1.1 -- the 33 node types BY SUBTRACTION from org/standards/NAMING_SCHEMA.json: kind.by_type keys (18, graded by kind) union types_not_graded_by_kind keys (15, disjoint), = 33, 0 uncovered.

axis.description: record s.4 -- WHICH RULE FAMILY a tension departs on (02_DOCTRINE.md sect. 2: A1-A5 with their rules; PROCESS = R18-R20; IDENTITY = the spine, 05_)

tension_kind.description: record s.4 -- WHAT MOVES to close a tension: HOME/FORMAT/GRAMMAR are 06_CONFORMANCE_LEDGER.md sect. 7's MIGRATE kinds, adopted; COMPUTE/DECLARATION/PROCESS/IDENTITY name the remaining move classes the canon's rules imply. FORK is a row kind (row_kind) and never a tension kind.

edge_type.description: record s.6, adopted whole from evidence-model.md's edge vocabulary (the diagram renderer's), for the flow diagram

subject.description: record s.0, s.3.1 -- the run's registry key (a scopes.json or systems.json key, never a spelling), with its vintage. These fields are the run's OWN vintage/identity stamp and are plain strings, not cells: they are not a measured fact about a resource, they are the coordinate every row's measurement is taken against.

trigger_denominator.description: record s.1.3 -- both trigger APIs measured (EVENT_RULE + SCHEDULE are two AWS services, both read; a one-API denominator undercounts silently). Each cell.

resource_or_plane_row.description: record s.1.2, s.3.1 -- a RESOURCE (one node of one of the 33 types) or PLANE (one tier-plane prefix) row: a CURRENT half (measured) and a DESIRED half (built, never typed), every field a cell.

current.description: record s.3.1 -- current.name, current.arn_or_path, current.drift_class, current.declaration, current.live, current.client_facing on every row, plus s.3.2's per-class extras; every field a cell.

desired.description: record s.3.1 -- desired.form (NEVER typed), desired.builder (the call verbatim), desired.verdict (NAMING_SCHEMA.json grade.verdicts + RAISE + NOT_GRADED + NOT_COVERED), desired.missing_registry_row (populated only on RAISE); every field a cell.

mark.description: record s.3.1 -- which of the three existing marks carries this row (remediations.json surface | LEGACY_SERVED_PATHS.json path | scopes.json alias bucket), or none. Not a cell: it names WHICH carrier, not a measured fact.

fork_row.description: record s.1.2, s.3.2 -- a set of >= 2 rows whose DESIRED form is ONE string, carried as a row so it has its own status, evidence and canonical member.

canonical_member.description: record s.3.2 -- a member row_id, or RULING-OWED with the decider named

tension.description: record s.4 -- one disagreement between a row's halves, three fields with three intents (axis, deciding_rules, kind) plus factors (four MEASURED cells).

deciding_rules.description: record s.4 -- WHICH RULE'S TEST the facts failed; cite the DECIDING rule, never the axis's whole list
